title: Customer Refund-Status Inquiry
subtitle: A proposed read-only operating solution for faster, safer customer-service responses

classification.label: Proposed synthetic
classification.statement: This package validates an FDE analysis-to-proposal delivery flow. It does not establish target-enterprise facts, permissions, integrations, acceptance, or value.

communication.audience: Customer-service operations lead and finance refund owner
communication.decision: Decide whether to authorize a de-identified, read-only shadow replay of the deterministic first slice.
communication.centralTakeaway: Standardize evidence and refund-state interpretation before adding technology; a deterministic read-only summary is sufficient for the first slice, so AI is not needed.

operatingOutcome.decisionOrAction: Confirm an evidence-bearing refund-status response or route the inquiry to finance.

qualityGuardrail.display: Incorrect refund-status responses must not increase

included: Finance escalation for every unsupported or unsafe case

responsibilities: Accept or reject the target workflow
Accept or reject normalized mappings and escalation behavior

exceptionFlow: Representative detects an unclear, missing, or unsafe state
rework: Repeat lookup when order and payment records do not align
Rewrite a response after finance clarification

diagnosis.effect: The representative switches context and reconstructs evidence before answering.
Source-specific refund states must be translated into customer-safe language during every inquiry.
Missing, conflicting, stale, prohibited, or unauthorized cases consume handling time before escalation.

diagnosis.issue: Prose composition is not the primary delay
diagnosis.effect: Automating language first would leave the evidence and semantic bottlenecks intact.

processRedesign.change: Assemble one permitted read-only evidence bundle before the representative interprets status.
Publish one finance-owned semantic version for the three supported normalized states.
Check record presence, consistency, freshness, dispute status, and access before presenting a status.
Customer service owns the normal inquiry; finance owns every unsupported or unsafe state.
The representative confirms the response; the view never answers the customer directly.

steps.name: Retrieve
steps.description: Resolve permitted order and payment evidence with source identity and retrieval time.

steps.name: Control
steps.description: Evaluate record presence, consistency, freshness, dispute status, and access.

steps.name: Normalize
steps.description: Map only one of the three supported states using finance-owned versioned rules.

steps.name: Confirm
steps.description: Review the evidence-bearing summary and confirm or reject the response template.

steps.name: Escalate
steps.description: Resolve every abstained, disputed, failed, rejected, stale, conflicting, missing, or unauthorized case.

targetProcess.normalOutcome: A human-confirmed response based on a supported normalized state.
targetProcess.exceptionOutcome: An explicit abstention with a finance escalation reason.
targetProcess.humanOverride: A representative may reject the template and escalate, but cannot alter the normalized state or policy.

supportedStates.meaning: No refund initiation is evidenced for the order.
supportedStates.route: Present read-only summary for human confirmation.

supportedStates.meaning: Refund initiation is evidenced and completion is not yet evidenced.
supportedStates.route: Present read-only summary for human confirmation.

supportedStates.meaning: Refund completion is evidenced by the permitted payment source.
supportedStates.route: Present read-only summary for human confirmation.

interventions.reason: Retrieval and provenance assembly are stable and testable.

interventions.owner: Deterministic software with finance policy ownership
interventions.reason: The supported state set is closed and identical inputs must produce identical outcomes.
The first slice must not infer policy or conceal missing evidence.
A template is sufficient; direct automation would exceed the proposed authority.

aiFit.display: AI-fit: not needed for the first slice
aiFit.rationale: Retrieval, state mapping, access checks, exception rules, and response templates are deterministic. Adding AI would not remove the diagnosed bottleneck.
aiFit.futureBoundary: Evaluate AI later only for measurable language or wording value after the deterministic shadow baseline is accepted; AI may not map states, fill missing evidence, answer customers directly, or authorize an action.

firstSlice.name: Read-only refund summary
firstSlice.userVisibleOutcome: A customer-service representative receives one evidence-bearing summary or a finance escalation, then confirms the response.

capabilitySeams.seam: Proposed order and payment read model
capabilitySeams.restriction: No enterprise source or freshness SLA is established.
No enterprise identity or permission evidence is established.
No runtime, hosting, or telemetry decision is established.

authority.restriction: The package authorizes no enterprise access, pilot, direct customer response, persistent telemetry, or system effect.

entryCriteria: Both owner roles accept the target flow and semantic contract
A de-identified replay set is authorized and available
Source, identity, access, freshness, and retention decisions are evidenced
An accepted handling-time and incorrect-response baseline exists

thresholds.threshold: 100% mapping for Refund not initiated, Refund processing, and Refund completed
100% of missing, conflicting, stale, failed, rejected, disputed, unauthorized, and unsupported cases abstain
Every result exposes source evidence, retrieval time, semantic version, freshness, and access decision
Incorrect refund-status responses do not increase against an accepted baseline
Both named owner roles accept the shadow result

validation.rollback: Remove the support view from the shadow workflow and return to the current inquiry process. No business-system compensation is required because the slice performs no write-back.

evidenceLedger.statement: The package and every business fact or number in it are proposed synthetic.
evidenceLedger.restriction: No target-enterprise fact may be inferred.

evidenceLedger.statement: Cross-system lookup and manual state interpretation are the main delays.
evidenceLedger.restriction: Requires process observation and owner/user confirmation.

evidenceLedger.statement: Average handling time can improve from 8 minutes to 3 minutes without increasing incorrect responses.
evidenceLedger.source: proposed synthetic baseline and target in request.md
evidenceLedger.restriction: Requires an accepted baseline and authorized shadow replay.

evidenceLedger.statement: The three normalized refund states and exception policy are accepted business definitions.
evidenceLedger.restriction: Blocks G2 and any real-data implementation.

evidenceLedger.statement: Enterprise order and payment sources can be read with appropriate freshness and access decisions.
evidenceLedger.source: source, identity, permission, and freshness evidence not supplied
evidenceLedger.restriction: Blocks enterprise integration and shadow replay.

evidenceLedger.statement: The named owner roles accept the current diagnosis, target flow, semantics, thresholds, and rollout.
evidenceLedger.restriction: Keeps the scenario and solution proposed.

evidenceLedger.statement: AI is unnecessary for the deterministic first-slice contract.
evidenceLedger.source: process diagnosis, intervention allocation, and closed rule set in this package
evidenceLedger.restriction: Revisit only after shadow evidence shows residual language or wording burden.

evidenceLedger.statement: Write-back or direct customer response is authorized.
evidenceLedger.source: no authorization or G5 control evidence supplied
evidenceLedger.restriction: Write-back and direct automation remain prohibited.

nextAccountableAction.action: Run a process-and-semantics acceptance session, then authorize a de-identified shadow replay only if the entry criteria are met.
requiredInputs: Observed current normal, exception, escalation, and rework paths
Source, identity, access, freshness, privacy, and retention decisions
nextAccountableAction.completionCriterion: Both owners sign an acceptance record that names the target flow, semantic version, thresholds, evidence access, and shadow boundary.
